summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for integration documentation page. All 9 required features successfully tested and functional including documentation page load, 5 tabs navigation (Overview, Authentication, API Endpoints, Webhooks, Sandbox), code block copy functionality, expandable endpoint cards, and Back to Home link.

Overview tab shows Quick Start with all 4 steps: Get API Keys, Test in Sandbox, Implement OAuth, Go Live
Overview tab displays Rate Limits table with all 4 tiers: Sandbox, Starter, Professional, Enterprise
Authentication tab shows OAuth 2.0 flow with visual representation
Authentication tab displays 3-step authorization process: Request Authorization, Exchange Code for Token, Use Access Token
Authentication tab includes authorization URL with proper parameters
Authentication tab shows token exchange code example with proper headers
Authentication tab displays Security Best Practices warning section
API Endpoints tab loads with all 4 categorized sections: RECEIPTS, DRAWS, USERS, ADMIN
API Endpoints tab shows categorized endpoints (Receipts: 3, Draws: 3, Users: 2, Admin: 2)
Endpoint cards are expandable and clickable (tested with first endpoint)
Webhooks tab displays Webhook Endpoint configuration section

Webhooks tab lists all 6 available events: receipt.scanned, receipt.rejected, draw.started, draw.completed, user.milestone, fraud.detected

Sandbox tab shows Sandbox Credentials with base URL, test client ID, and test secret

Modern dark theme styling applied consistently across all tabs
Responsive layout with proper sidebar and content area
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, navigation) are functional
